prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. One isolated hand-painted 2D character asset for 茶园物语, a gentle traditional Chinese tea-village game. Chinese ink outlines and pale watercolor wash matching approved protagonist art. Thin warm-grey/brown outlines, simple clean broad washes, minimal clothing folds, no grain/no noisy mottling/no dense texture/no muddy haze/no oversaturation/no hard black outline/no glossy render. Palette muted sage/tea greens, ivory, pale brown, oatmeal, charcoal-grey, restrained clay rose. Skin soft natural peach, no strong blush or shiny highlight. Complete SINGLE character, full body including hair and both feet, generous true transparent alpha margin on all sides. Transparent gaps between limbs, no background color, no drawn checkerboard, no ground/shadow plate or halo. No environment, furniture, tea plants, handheld cups, trays, tools, weapons, writing, numbers, labels or watermarks. Fixed clothing accessories such as pendant and cloth bag belong to the character. Calm friendly expressions. Keep hand anatomy simple and natural. Character family stylized about3.5heads tall for full-body dialogue portraits, about3heads for scene sprites; never photorealistic. Scene sprites use a consistent elevated parallel-axonometric camera and three-quarter front-left facing, head top slightly visible, feet on the same implied horizontal plane, no converging perspective. Portraits use near frontal three-quarter pose. No animation sheet or multiple copies.
SUBJECT: Image1 is STYLE/PROPORTION reference ONLY, not identity to copy. Generate a NEW teaching companion full-body DIALOGUE PORTRAIT: a friendly capable young adult woman, dark-brown hair tied into a compact high bun with a simple ivory cloth band, no teal hair tuft. Warm brown eyes, modest assured smile. Muted sage short work tunic with fitted practical sleeves, ivory long apron over oatmeal loose trousers, small pale-brown tied tool pouch at her waist, brown cloth shoes. Hands EMPTY, one open hand gently welcoming, other relaxed. No tools inside hand, no leaf, no bowl. Compact readable silhouette, same stylized3.5-head family and pale watercolor as hero; distinct hair and apron. Full-body1024x1536portraitcanvas.
